subject: general
question: The ______ sector is the largest sector of India, contributing to a Gross Value Added (GVA) of ₹92.26 lakh crore in 2018-19.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Service**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Service sector** is the largest sector in India, contributing significantly to the economy.
 
• In the fiscal year 2018-19, the Service sector contributed a Gross Value Added (GVA) of ₹92.26 lakh crore.
 
• This sector includes industries such as IT, telecommunications, finance, real estate, and hospitality, among others.
 
• The Service sector has been a major driver of India's economic growth and employment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's economy is divided into three main sectors: Agriculture, Industry, and Services.
 
• The **Agriculture sector** includes farming, forestry, and fishing, while the **Industry sector** comprises manufacturing, mining, and construction.
 
• The Service sector's growth has been fueled by advancements in technology and increasing globalization.
 
• Policies and reforms aimed at liberalizing the economy have also played a crucial role in the expansion of the Service sector.
